name: schlo episode 1: murder
source:
Play as Drey Gan, a teenage boy who falls into a depressive state after a shocking event that establishes his relationship with a group of suspicious guys who want to date him. The game attempts to have a bit of a light-hearted feel, while dealing with dark topics. There are brief mentions of abuse, suicide and incest. These themes are unapologetically presented but not condoned. Their assessment and analysis is left up to the individual player. 
Remake of the first half of the first schlo visual novel: what is schlo? which was released in late 2018.
[From [url=https://krt-org.itch.io/schlo-episode-1-murder] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演少年Drey Gan。在经历一件震惊的事件后，他陷入抑郁，也因此和一群可疑男子扯上关系；他们都想和他约会。游戏试图以轻松的基调讲述沉重议题，其中简短提及虐待、自杀和乱伦。这些主题未经粉饰地呈现，但不代表作品赞同；如何评估和分析，留给每位玩家自行判断。
本作重制了第一部《schlo》视觉小说《what is schlo?》的前半部分，原作于2018年底推出。

[引自[url=https://krt-org.itch.io/schlo-episode-1-murder]Itch.io[/url]]
